lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a regular grid-like matrix posterior to the gill slits, forming distinct vertical columns and horizontal tiers across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating high-contrast anchor nodes at the points of overlap.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features run horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadow-induced low intensity on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of medium-luminance circular blobs visible within the boundaries of the first dorsal fin silhouette, partially attenuated by water depth and turbidity.

other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, more concentrated high-luminance spots compared to the larger blobs on the primary flank.
